rubrics.justification: Provides a plausible blastocyst assessment with expansion, ICM, TE, and zona comments, but some details appear overconfident from a single image and may over-specify features such as exact ICM position and grading.
Integrates age, tubal factor, AMH, BMI, prior cycle, sperm quality, and endometrium well with embryo prognosis, though some links are somewhat speculative.

Overall logic is clear and internally consistent, with a reasonable probability estimate tied to embryo quality and patient factors; minor overreach includes implying implantation issues after only one failed cycle.

Recommendations are largely consistent with IVF practice, especially SET in a young patient and hydrosalpinx evaluation, though suggesting PGT-A and ERA early after a single failed transfer is more aggressive than standard guideline-based practice.

Gives practical next steps for current transfer and contingency planning, including SET, tubal reassessment, luteal support, and future workup, though some recommendations could be better prioritized.
